pages.text: The Akaishi Ingot is the $(bold)core material$(0) of mid-to-late-game machines and gear.$(br2)$(bold)One way to get it:$(0) feed $(4)10M Akaishi Energy + 1 Netherite Ingot$(0) into the "$(l:akaishi:aggregator)Energy Aggregator$(/l)" and it condenses 1 ingot.$(br2)There is no furnace shortcut — $(e)without 10M-scale storage you can't mass-produce$(0). Keep the Ancient Debris you mine; it's the ingredient that gets you here.

The ingot is the $(bold)king of upstream materials$(0): the upgrade template, reactor fuel rods and shells, the fuel canner, fusion and wireless parts... a whole stack of premium recipes is built on it, and "$(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l)" is fed by it too.$(br2)$(bold)Spending advice$(0): secure your share for the Equipment Forger and upgrade templates first — $(4)you can never have enough ingots$(0). If the grid can take it, leave the Aggregator running and let them pile up: $(e)each ingot is a Netherite Ingot, upgraded$(0).

How you got here: crystals → blocks → essence (see "Crystal & Essence") built your fortune → the grid reached 10M-scale storage → the Aggregator started condensing → and now ingots flow into the Equipment Forger. Read how to set up the Aggregator before you talk about getting rich.
